critical_code_review_comments: TestResume fixture (backend/tests/test_pathforge.py::_ensure_resume) calls POST /api/resume/generate when the class fixture's user has no resume. Because that user is fresh each session, this fixture will always hit the LLM and error out while the budget is exhausted. Consider seeding a resume in the fixture directly via the save endpoint, or skipping the Resume class when AI is unavailable. Not a regression from this fix pass; pre-existing design.
